story.introduction: Zara wakes up in a cold, dark dungeon. The last thing she remembers is chasing a strange light into the forest. The walls hum with a cursed energy. A voice echoes: 'Ten floors stand between you and freedom. Survive them all.' She grips her bomb and steps forward.
story.development: Halfway through the first floor, Zara finds a scratched message on the wall: 'The Grue King feeds on fear. Destroy his minions and weaken his power.' She realizes the creatures hunting her are not random — they are his eyes.
story.conclusion: Floor 1 cleared. The exit door creaks open. Zara exhales, but the staircase ahead spirals deeper into darkness. Nine floors remain. The real challenge has not yet begun.
